View the prompt
Set up the full Azivor Reference plugin in my signed-in ChatGPT account for Chat, Work and Codex where supported. Use Plugin Creator in Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app. Carry out setup rather than only explaining it.

I authorize downloading and inspecting the bundle, creating or updating my private plugin, connecting and installing it, and opening one new Chat-mode conversation to run one read-only image search. Reuse existing matching connections and plugins. Do not publish or share my private copy. These routine setup actions and access to Azivor's public reference images are authorized without repeated permission questions. Keep authorization limited to this plugin; preserve global approval, security and workspace settings. Let me complete any product-required sign-in, consent or installation approval, then continue.

1. Download https://azivor.github.io/reference/plugin/azivor-reference-0acfeb10a9c4.zip and verify SHA-256 0acfeb10a9c4f7103faffc774e247ec6c1352363a8722125a04ba461ce584efd. Inspect and extract it. This is a SOURCE BUNDLE, not the finished ChatGPT upload. It contains plugin.json, mcp.json, the image-display skill, the Reference PNG and scripts/build-chatgpt-package.py. Uploading its portable MCP config directly produces a desktop-only plugin; do not treat that as successful Chat support.
2. Register or reuse the ChatGPT account connection FIRST. In ChatGPT Plugins, use Add > Add custom MCP server with name Azivor Reference API, URL https://azivor-reference.vercel.app/mcp and No authentication. For an existing connection, verify its URL in its settings. For a new connection, complete the supported setup/consent flow, then inspect its settings and copy its actual App ID. Use only the ID returned for MY account. Never use an ID from another user, a plugin ID, a version ID or a guessed placeholder. If custom connections are unavailable, stop and explain that account limitation.
3. Inspect the bundled Python builder, then run it with Python 3: python3 <extracted-bundle>/scripts/build-chatgpt-package.py --app-id <verified-App-ID> --output <temporary-directory>/azivor-reference-chatgpt.zip. Substitute real paths and the verified ID. This builds the full account plugin with both its image-display skill and .app.json connection binding. It removes portable MCP declarations from the upload so it works in Chat mode. No new website, server deployment, OpenAI API key or payment method is needed.
4. Use Plugin Creator to create the private plugin from THAT GENERATED ZIP and install/connect it through the supported account flow. Reuse an existing correctly bound Azivor Reference plugin rather than duplicating it. If repairing a previous desktop-only copy, inspect its current files/release first, preserve its exact identity and relevant metadata, synchronize any compatibility manifest, and explicitly remove the old mcp.json and .mcp.json through the supported update/delete-path workflow. Never overwrite another plugin or disconnect a shared connection. A correct existing plugin does not need a pointless update.
5. Read back the saved plugin. Verify that it includes the azivor-reference skill, the Reference logo and the verified account App binding, with no leftover local-only MCP declaration. In the plugin page, require Apps with the expected connection marked Connected, Skills with azivor-reference, and Try in chat. An Open in desktop app button plus MCP servers alone is NOT a passing result. Do not substitute a standalone local skill or Codex-only MCP setting.
6. Start the authorized new conversation using Try in chat and confirm Chat is selected, not Work. Select the installed full plugin and ask: Show me three Perplexity references. Use its real search tool with limit 3. Preserve returned image blocks and inline UI metadata; if necessary, embed exact returned preview URLs as Markdown images. Verify that three actual reference images render with notes/source links, not merely that a tool succeeded. Do not generate replacement artwork. If the host cannot run or inspect this Chat-mode test, state what remains unverified instead of claiming success.
7. Give me the private plugin link and the Chat-mode test conversation link, with the verified installation and image-display result. Keep required account consent enabled.

If Plugin Creator or browser access is missing, ask me to enable the missing capability, continue independent preparation, and link https://azivor.github.io/reference/#chatgpt for manual connection details. Do not claim local-only setup supplies ChatGPT Chat support.
Set up manually

  1. Open ChatGPT plugins

    Choose Add → Add custom MCP server.

    Open ChatGPT plugins

  2. Enter the connection

    Name
    Azivor Reference
    Server URL
    https://azivor-reference.vercel.app/mcp

    Authentication No authentication

    Plugin image · optionalDownload PNG

    Review and confirm the warning, then choose Create as a plugin.

  3. Install and start a chat

    Install the plugin. In a new Work chat, type @ and select Azivor Reference.

    Show me three Perplexity references.

Requires Plugin Creator for easy setup and an account that allows custom connections.
